description: Cold Chain Monitoring Dataset: Temperature, Humidity and Vibration Data for TinyML Classification is published by Gorka Manzanares López-Ocaña; Ascensión López Vargas. The thesis dataset contains temperature, humidity and acceleration measurements for cold-chain anomaly classification. Its stated coverage is Experimental monitoring setups; normal and anomalous storage or transport conditions. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata and lists CSV resources; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is cc-by-4.0. The measurements support a specific Master's thesis and are not representative fleet-wide observations. For simulation, it can inform food-supply demand, capacity or disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record data-global-food-twin-food-flows provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
